g.title: No active maintenance fence; ordinary SQLite operations may seek their own transaction.
Exclusive maintenance owns validated staging and prior-state inventory; ordinary access is blocked.
The validated new store is active; cleanup must preserve truthful commitment and cannot roll back as retry.
